semantic_meaning: Reveals hidden system layers (structure, control, incentives) beneath the visible surface.
when_to_use: To reveal the hidden layer that makes the claim true
When the audience needs 'x-ray vision' into a black box
When shifting from surface narrative to controllable structure
when_not_to_use: If the hidden layers are speculative or not supported by sources
As a generic visual effect without an actual layer reveal
If the reveal would clutter the frame beyond mobile readability

animation_behavior.description: Surface fades/peels; structure layer appears in cyan; leverage highlight in amber; optional consequence overlay in red (only if explicit).

input_parameters.name: leverage_layer_id
input_parameters.description: Layer ID where the amber leverage highlight appears.

expected_outputs: A readable layer reveal that grounds the mechanism visually
validation_notes: Do not use red unless the claim is explicitly about consequence/failure/exposure.
